parameters.query: SELECT f.id,f.inspection_id,f.finding_type,f.entity_type,f.canonical_key,f.field_name,f.expected_value,f.actual_value,f.absolute_delta,f.relative_delta,f.severity,f.status,f.title,f.description,f.explanation,f.detector_version,f.dedup_key,f.created_at,f.updated_at,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('side',e.side,'document_id',e.document_id,'document_name',d.original_filename,'document_stage',d.stage,'page_id',e.page_id,'page_number',p.page_number,'text_block_id',e.text_block_id,'bbox',e.bbox,'quote',e.quote,'entity_id',e.entity_id,'download_url','/api/v1/documents/' || d.id || '/download-url') ORDER BY e.side,e.id) FROM finding_evidence e JOIN document_pages p ON p.id=e.page_id JOIN documents d ON d.id=e.document_id WHERE e.finding_id=f.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS evidence FROM findings f WHERE f.id=$1::uuid
